The structure of composition Ce2Ag2Si4 (reduced formula CeAgSi2) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P-1 (No. 2), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Ag centers with 10 geometric neighbors (2 Ag, 4 Ce, 4 Si), Ce centers with 14 neighbors (2 Ag, 8 Si, 4 Ce), and Si centers with 10 neighbors (2 Ag, 3 Ce, 5 Si). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all eight sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between 10-vertex Ag polyhedra and corner- and face-sharing between 10-vertex Ag and 14-vertex Ce polyhedra.
